title: Multiple stores
prompt: Attach several stores at session creation and verify current limits and restrictions on later attachment changes.

examples.code:
resources:
  - type: memory_store
    memory_store_id: STANDARDS_STORE_ID
    access: read_only
  - type: memory_store
    memory_store_id: PROJECT_STORE_ID
    access: read_only
  - type: memory_store
    memory_store_id: USER_STORE_ID
    access: read_write
